objective: Record every pinned file of transport-udt 4.2.19.Final as not ported, with its reason, CLR counterpart and evidence (the UDT transport is deprecated upstream); see docs/record-only-modules.md.

ownerDecisions: No project: the module is recorded, not ported (the UDT transport is deprecated upstream). Owner decision 2026-11-16 (JVM-only units are recorded with their CLR counterpart instead of placeholder files) and 2026-11-23 (units that need a Java library without a BCL counterpart are recorded, not ported).

statusMeaning.deprecated-not-ported: @Deprecated Java unit (or a unit that serves one) recorded with its deprecation facts; no [Obsolete] facade.
statusMeaning.jvm-only-replaced: JVM-only unit replaced by its recorded CLR counterpart, or JVM build/runtime material with no CLR counterpart.
statusMeaning.library-not-ported: Needs a Java library or JDK-specific API with no BCL counterpart (owner decision 2026-11-23); recorded, not ported.
statusMeaning.clr-adapted: Ported with the original names, structure and comments; every CLR difference is stated in a // CLR: comment and in this entry.
statusMeaning.verified: Every declared original test is mapped to a C# test with the same name (case may differ) and passes.

notPorted.sourceContract: Java type DefaultUdtChannelConfig of transport-udt: The default UdtChannelConfig implementation.
notPorted.reason: The io.netty.channel.udt package is @deprecated ("The UDT transport is no longer maintained and will be removed.") and needs the barchart UDT JNI library; deprecated units are recorded without an [Obsolete] facade (owner decision 2026-11-16).

replacement.clr: None in Netty.NET: the CLR has no UDT stack; TCP and UDP channels are NioSocketChannel and NioDatagramChannel.
noClrCounterpart: The UDT protocol (UDP-based reliable transport) and its rendezvous mode.
